author: Trevor Kearing
title: Apple (AAPL) Reaches New 1-Year High at $230.00
text:
Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) shares hit a new 52-week high during mid-day company traded as high as $230.00 and last traded at $229.80, with a volume of 1138723 shares changing hands. $227.26.
A number of research analysts have recently issued reports on the company. Loop Capital upped their price target on Apple from $195.00 to $210.00 and gave the company a “buy” rating in a report on Friday, July 6th. BidaskClub downgraded Apple from a “strong-buy” rating to a “buy” rating in a report on Wednesday, September 12th. Morgan Stanley reaffirmed a “buy” rating and set a $247.00 price target on shares of Apple in a report on Wednesday, September 26th. Royal Bank of Canada reaffirmed a “buy” rating and set a $240.00 price target on shares of Apple in a report on Tuesday, September 11th. Finally, Wells Fargo & Co set a $210.00 price target on Apple and gave the company a “neutral” rating in a report on Wednesday, September 5th. Two investment analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, nineteen have issued a hold rating and thirty have given a buy rating to the company’s stock. The company currently has a consensus rating of “Buy” and a consensus target price of $220.78.
Get Apple alerts: The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.84, a current ratio of 1.31 and a quick ratio of 1.24. The stock has a market capitalization of $1,109.54 billion, a P/E ratio of 25.20, a PEG ratio of 1.99 and a beta of 1.36.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last issued its quarterly earnings results on Tuesday, July 31st. The iPhone maker reported $2.34 EPS for the quarter, topping analysts’ consensus estimates of $2.18 by $0.16. The business had revenue of $53.27 billion during analysts’ expectations of $52.43 billion. Apple had a return on equity of 43.50% and a net margin of 21.98%. The business’s quarterly revenue was up 17.3% on a year-over-year basis. During the same quarter in the prior year, the business posted $1.67 earnings per share. analysts forecast that Apple Inc. will post 11.76 earnings per share for the current fiscal year.

Following the completion of the sale, the director now owns 1,153,283 shares in the company, valued at $238,245,202.14. Cook sold 265,160 shares of the company’s stock in a transaction dated Monday, August 27th. The stock was sold at an average price of $217.79, for a total value of $57,749,196.40. About Apple ( NASDAQ:AAPL )
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers to consumers, and small and mid-sized businesses; and education, enterprise, and government customers worldwide. The company also sells related software, services, accessories, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications.
